snippet.title: Up-Back-Through ⚽️ | Why Red Bull Teams Train to Play Narrow
snippet.description:
One of the most common principles in football is that a team in possession should spread wide to create more space and gain more time on the ball.

But what if you deliberately do the opposite?

Red Bull teams, including RB Leipzig, have built much of their attacking philosophy around playing through central areas, often using a 4-2-2-2 formation.

Many of their training exercises, even at youth level, are organised within a narrow central channel, approximately 40 metres wide — the width of the penalty area.

In this exercise, we apply the same principle:

➡️ Close the wide areas
➡️ Force the team to play through the central channel
➡️ Encourage players to find solutions under pressure
➡️ Use combinations to break defensive lines

The interesting outcome?

These conditions naturally create beautiful UP → BACK → THROUGH combinations.

➡️ UP: Play vertically into a teammate between the lines
➡️ BACK: Set the ball to a supporting player facing forward
➡️ THROUGH: Exploit the space behind the defensive line with a penetrating pass

Instead of using width to create space, players learn to manipulate opponents through positioning, timing and quick combinations.

The key coaching principle?

Sometimes restricting space in training can help players discover more effective solutions to progress through the pitch.

UP → BACK → THROUGH.

A simple but powerful attacking pattern that can be particularly effective when playing through congested central areas.

😂🔥 **ചിരിയുടെ പൂരവുമായി ഇതാ Comedy Masters Episode 344!**

സ്വേത മേനോന്റെ സാന്നിധ്യവും അലീന പടിക്കലിന്റെ അവതരണവും കിടിലൻ കോമഡി സ്കിറ്റുകളും രസകരമായ സംഭാഷണങ്ങളും ഗെയിമുകളുമായി മറ്റൊരു എന്റർടെയ്ൻമെന്റ് എപ്പിസോഡ് കൂടി! 🎭❤️

കുട്ടി അഖിൽ, അലീന, ശ്രീവിദ്യ, അർജുൻ ഗോപാൽ, ആലീസ്, അഖിൽ കവലയൂർ എന്നിവരുടെ രസകരമായ നിമിഷങ്ങൾക്കൊപ്പം ചിരിയും കളിയും നിറഞ്ഞ ഈ എപ്പിസോഡ് ആസ്വദിക്കാം! 🤣

🎉 **Episode 344 Highlights:**

🎤 **Intro Chat** – രസകരമായ സംഭാഷണങ്ങളുമായി എപ്പിസോഡിന് തുടക്കം!

😂 **ജന്തർ മന്തർ സ്കിറ്റ്** – ലാൽ ബാബു, അനീഷ് സാരഥി, അശ്വതി, ശിവദാസ് എന്നിവർ ചേർന്നുള്ള കോമഡി വിരുന്ന്.

🪣 **കിണർ സ്കിറ്റ്** – രാധിക, സോന, പ്രണവ് എന്നിവർ ഒന്നിക്കുന്ന കോമ്പറ്റീഷൻ സ്കിറ്റും രസകരമായ ഫൺ ചാറ്റും!

snippet.title: Buxa Tiger Reserve | এনক্লোজার থেকে উধাও বাঘিনি, পানবাড়িতে নজরদারি বন দফতরের | Bangla News
snippet.description:
Buxa Tiger Reserve | এবার সিঁধ কেটে এনক্লোজার থেকে গায়েব বাঘিনি। কয়েকদিন আগে বক্সা থেকে অসমের জঙ্গলে চলে যায়। ঘুমপাড়ানি গুলিতে বাঘিনিকে কাবু করা হয়। বক্সা টাইগার রিজার্ভের এনক্লোজারে ছাড়া হয়।গতকাল ফের এনক্লোজার থেকে উধাও ডুয়ার্সরানি। পরে বক্সা টাইগার রিজার্ভের পানবাড়ি এলাকায় খোঁজ। বাঘিনির উপর নজরদারি বন দফতরের। ঘুমপাড়ানি গুলিতে কাবু করার প্রক্রিয়া শুরু।

The tigress has once again managed to escape from her enclosure. A few days ago, she had wandered from Buxa into the forests of Assam; she was subsequently tranquilized and brought back to an enclosure within the Buxa Tiger Reserve. Yesterday, the tigress—known as 'Dooarsrani'—vanished from the enclosure once more. She was later located in the Panbari area of ​​the Buxa Tiger Reserve. The Forest Department is currently monitoring her, and the process to tranquilize her has begun.

ट्रंप तो हारे ही हारे साथ में नेतनयाहू की PM की गद्दी भी अब चली ही गई समझो। और उनको बाहर कर दिया इज़रायल के अरब नागरिकों ने। तो ये समझने वाली बात है कि इज़रायल में अरब नागिरक कौन लोग हैं जो वोट भी कर सकते हैं वहां पर? इज़रायल तो यहूदियों का देश है, तो ये 20% अरब कौन हैं? ग़ाज़ा और वेस्ट बैंक वाले हैं क्या ये लोग? नहीं, ये वो नहीं हैं। वो तो इज़रायल के चुनाव में वोट ही नहीं कर सकते। तो फिर ये कौन लोग हैं ये पूरा समझने की ज़रूरत है। इतना अब तो यहां की पब्लिक को भी पता चल गया कि इज़रायल की संसद में 120 सीटें हैं और वहां मोटे तौर पर तीन धड़े लड़ रहे थे चुनाव। एक था नेतनयाहू का गठबंधन, वो है यहूदी पार्टियों का। दूसरा था गादी आज़ेनकोट वाला गठबंधन, वो भी है यहूदी पार्टियों का। और तीसरा धड़ा था अरब पार्टियों का। 61 सीटें चाहिए थीं सरकार बनाने के लिए। वो तीनों में किसी की नहीं आईं। यहूदी पार्टियों में नेतनयाहू की साइड को मिलीं 53 सीटें, गादी आज़ेनकोट वाली साइड को मिलीं 48 सीटें, और बाक़ी 19 सीटें मिलीं अरब पार्टियों को। 61 किसी को नहीं मिलीं। तो या तो दोनों यहूदी धड़े मिल कर यहूदी एकता की सरकार बनाते। या गादी आइज़ेनकोट वाली साइड अरब पार्टियों का समर्थन लेती तब सरकार बनती। चक्कर क्या था कि हमास के जो तीन साल पहले हमले हुए थे उसके बाद से यहूदी पार्टियां अरब पार्टियों का समर्थन लेते हुए दिखना नहीं चाह रही थीं। लेकिन जब ट्रंप की पार्टी अमेरिका में हार गई तो यहूदी पार्टियों को भी साफ़ संकेत मिल गया कि ट्रंप की विरोधी डेमोक्रैटिक पार्टी इज़रायल का भले ही समर्थन करती रहे, नेतनयाहू का नहीं करेगा। 

Trump lost, and Netanyahu lost his PM position as well. And he was ousted by Israel's Arab citizens. So, it's important to understand who the Arab citizens of Israel are who can vote there? Israel is a Jewish country, so who are these 20% Arabs? Are they from Gaza and the West Bank? No, they aren't. They can't even vote in Israeli elections. So, it's important to fully understand who these people are. By now, even the local public knows that there are 120 seats in the Israeli parliament, and broadly speaking, three factions were contesting the elections. One was Netanyahu's coalition, composed of Jewish parties. The second was Gadi Azenkot's coalition, also composed of Jewish parties. The third was the Arab parties. 61 seats were needed to form a government, but none of the three secured them. Among the Jewish parties, Netanyahu's side won 53 seats, Gadi Eizenkot's side won 48, and the remaining 19 seats went to Arab parties. No one secured 61. So, either the two Jewish factions would have come together to form a Jewish unity government, or Gadi Eizenkot's side would have secured the support of Arab parties, and then a government would have been formed. The problem was that after the Hamas attacks three years ago, Jewish parties were reluctant to be seen as taking the support of Arab parties. But when Trump's party lost in America, Jewish parties also got a clear signal that Trump's opposition, the Democratic Party, may continue to support Israel, but will not support Netanyahu.

So, either the two Jewish factions would have come together to form a Jewish unity government, or Gadi Eizenkot's side would have secured the support of Arab parties, and then a government would have been formed. snippet.title: Чутки живуть своїм життям… А ми своїм! 😉
snippet.description:
Кажуть, що ми продали будинок і виїхали до Польщі. А я хочу сказати ось що: у нас навіть думки не було кудись виїжджати!
Я дуже люблю свій дім, наше подвір’я і все, що ми тут створили власними руками та своєю працею. Кожен куточок будинку, кожна доріжка у дворі, усе наше. У всьому частинка нашої душі, стільки праці, років життя і спогадів.
Подорожувати, гостювати це чудово, але свій дім це зовсім інше.
Дай Боже, щоб усе було добре! Ми плануємо й надалі жити тут, будуватися, облаштовувати своє подвір’я і робити наш дім ще затишнішим.
А чутки хай живуть своїм життям, ми просто посміхаємося! #madamnadin

snippet.title: Caner Laftan Değil Teoman’ın Dayağından Anladı - Daha 17
snippet.description:
Teoman, Caner’e bedel ödetti. TERBİYE EDİYORUM
Daha 17 | 24. Bölümü izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtu.be/6LenRJEJ4y0

Aras, Serhat cinayetinin zanlısı olarak gözaltına alınırken Leyla fenalaşır. Hastaneden kaçan Aras, kendisini aklayacak delilin peşine düşerken Hakan bütün şüpheleri onun üzerine toplar. Şebnem de ailesini korumak için üstüne düşeni yapmak zorundadır. 

Babasının sözleri Teoman’ın Aras’a duyduğu güveni sarsar; Deniz ve Metin ise ona yardım eder. Serhat’ın katili Uğur’un itiraf kaydına ulaşan Aras, kendi adını temize çıkarmak kadar kardeşinin özgürlüğü için de çabalamaktadır. Ancak Aras’ın beklemediği şekilde onun işini zorlaştıran yine Teoman olacaktır.

Yurtlarda büyüyen 17 yaşındaki Aras’ın geçmişine ve ailesine ulaşma çabasını merkezine alan Daha On Yedi, İstanbul’da başlayıp Bodrum’a uzanan sürükleyici bir hikaye sunuyor.

For seven years Ada paid for Kalu's dreams. On their wedding day, in front of a full cathedral, he throws the ring on the marble floor, takes the microphone and tells everyone he won't marry her — then brings in a model named Brenda as his new bride.

Ada walks out into the rain with nothing. At the church gate she meets a quiet security guard named Zayn — and a few hours later, she marries him at the registry. Kalu and Brenda laugh at the "fat girl and her guard." They have no idea what either of them is hiding.

• Anyone who mocks your body was never worth your love.
